recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-shot portrait of a young man in a white shirt and denim, framed by sharp diagonal geometric blocks in teal and light green, featuring highly condensed, drop-shadowed typography typical of late 1980s pop aesthetics.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal teal bands framing the central subject
Contrast between the soft-lit portrait and hard-edged geometric shapes
Verticality of the condensed display type against the horizontal lean of the subject
Color harmony between the peach-toned skin/text and the teal background
coreInvariants: Highly condensed sans-serif or slab-serif display type
Heavy drop shadows on all text elements
Teal and mint green color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, seated, occupying the middle vertical third, slightly leaning to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large peach-colored name text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large name on the left, moves to the subject's face, then follows the diagonal lines to the song title in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Utilized within the teal diagonal bands to isolate text elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Teal and mint green (background and geometric overlays)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, slightly desaturated tones with a soft, grainy film texture.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy black drop shadows for legibility against busy backgrounds
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uniform stroke weight in the primary name text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrasting two different condensed styles: a geometric sans for the name and a more traditional slab for the title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and weight of the primary name text.
Captures the high-waisted, elegant condensed feel of the title text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus portrait of a man in a white shirt and jeans, seated against a mint green wall. Overlay large diagonal teal blocks on the top-right and bottom-left corners, separated by thin yellow lines.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed peach-colored text on the left with a black drop shadow. Add white condensed slab-serif text in the top right corner, staggered across three lines with a soft drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Are the diagonal lines sharp and consistent?
Is the text extremely condensed vertically?
Does the color palette lean heavily into teal and peach?
Is there a visible drop shadow on all text?

adjustableVariables: Font weight of the primary name
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the artist name and song title
postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not overlap the subject's face.
Ensure the diagonal lines are parallel.
Verify the drop shadows are consistent in direction.
Confirm the peach color is distinct from the skin tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-lit studio portrait with hard-edged diagonal teal overlays and ultra-condensed, shadowed typography in peach and white.
